_note: All 30 <pre> prompt bodies on prompts.html are Chinese inside frozen code (gate B), so none of them is edited in en/. policy.json marks this page 'rewrite': every prompt is restated in English and each one now ends with 'Answer in English.' so the agent does not reply in Chinese. API names (WebDAV, OCS API, CalDAV, CardDAV), product names (Nextcloud, Deck, Office, rclone), config keys (trusted_domains, config.php, cron) and every number (20, 7, 90, 30, 80%, 50GB, 15%, 2 PM) are kept exactly as the zh source has them, as is the confirm-before-acting clause on every destructive prompt. Chinese example values follow i18n/glossary.json decisions.code_placeholders ("Downloads", "Archive/2025", "Party photos", "dad", "Family", "Spring cleaning", "Moving plan", To do / In progress / Done). Full-width punctuation becomes ASCII; the <pre> tag carries no attributes, so gate A's tag skeleton is unchanged. Each block occurs exactly once.

entries.zh: 用 WebDAV 掃描我的檔案，列出前 20 大的檔案（含路徑與大小），先不要刪，讓我決定。
entries.en: Use WebDAV to scan my files and list the 20 largest ones (with path and size). Do not delete anything yet; let me decide. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把「下載」資料夾裡超過一年沒動過的檔案，整理到「封存/2025」資料夾（先列清單讓我確認）。
entries.en: Move the files in the "Downloads" folder that have not been touched for over a year into an "Archive/2025" folder (list them first so I can confirm). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 找出內容重複的檔案（用雜湊比對），列出重複組別與可釋放空間，不要自動刪。
entries.en: Find files with duplicate contents (compare hashes), list the duplicate groups and how much space they would free, and do not delete anything automatically. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把某個資料夾裡的檔案依副檔名分到子資料夾（圖片、文件、影片），先給我預覽對照表。
entries.en: Sort the files in one folder into subfolders by file extension (images, documents, videos), and show me a preview table first. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出回收桶內容與各自佔用空間，計算清空可釋放多少，等我確認再清。
entries.en: List what is in the trash bin and how much space each item takes, work out how much emptying it would free, and wait for my confirmation before you empty it. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 用 OCS API 列出我所有的分享：對象、權限、有無密碼與到期日，標出「公開且無密碼」的風險項。
entries.en: Use the OCS API to list all of my shares: who they are shared with, the permissions, whether they have a password and an expiration date. Flag the risky ones that are public with no password. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出 7 天內到期的分享連結，讓我決定要續期還是收回。
entries.en: List the share links that expire within 7 days, so I can decide whether to extend or revoke them. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 找出建立超過 90 天、且是公開連結的分享，列出清單，等我確認後停用。
entries.en: Find the shares that are public links and were created more than 90 days ago, list them, and disable them after I confirm. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把所有沒設密碼的公開分享，補上密碼與 30 天到期（先列出會影響幾個）。
entries.en: Add a password and a 30-day expiration date to every public share that has no password (list how many will be affected first). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 幫資料夾「聚會照片」建一個公開分享連結，唯讀、加密碼、7 天到期，回傳連結。
entries.en: Create a public share link for the folder "Party photos": read-only, with a password, expiring in 7 days, and return the link. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 用 OCS API 列出所有使用者：狀態（啟用/停用）、群組、配額與已用空間，標出停用中仍佔空間的。
entries.en: Use the OCS API to list every user: status (enabled/disabled), groups, quota and space used. Flag the disabled ones that are still taking up space. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 幫我建一個使用者「爸爸」，加入「家人」群組，配額 50GB，並回傳初始設定資訊（不要在對話貼明碼）。
entries.en: Create a user named "dad", add them to the "Family" group, give the account a 50GB quota, and return the initial setup details (do not paste the plaintext password in the conversation). Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出配額使用率超過 80% 的使用者，提醒我可能要加配額或請他們清理。
entries.en: List the users whose quota usage is over 80%, and remind me that I may need to raise their quota or ask them to clean up. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 把離開的成員帳號停用（不刪資料），列出被停用的帳號讓我複核。
entries.en: Disable the accounts of members who have left (do not delete their data), and list the disabled accounts so I can double-check. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 盤點目前 Nextcloud 的備份狀態：資料庫、資料目錄、config.php 各有沒有備份機制，缺口在哪。
entries.en: Take stock of the current Nextcloud backup situation: whether the database, the data directory and config.php each have a backup mechanism, and where the gaps are. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 寫一份 Nextcloud 災難還原步驟：假設伺服器掛了，怎麼從備份把資料庫與檔案還原回來。
entries.en: Write a Nextcloud disaster recovery procedure: assume the server is down, and describe how to restore the database and the files from a backup. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 規畫用 rclone 透過 WebDAV 把我的 Nextcloud 每日增量備份到另一個儲存，給我設定步驟。
entries.en: Plan a daily incremental backup of my Nextcloud to another storage target with rclone over WebDAV, and give me the setup steps. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 依過去一年的成長量，預估多久會用到儲存上限，並建議清理或擴充。
entries.en: Based on the past year's growth, estimate how long it will be until I hit the storage limit, and suggest what to clean up or expand. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 透過 CardDAV 把「家人」通訊錄匯出成 vCard 備份一份。
entries.en: Use CardDAV to export the "Family" address book as vCard and keep a backup copy. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 找出通訊錄裡疑似重複的聯絡人（同名或同電話），列出待合併清單讓我確認。
entries.en: Find contacts in the address book that look like duplicates (same name or same phone number), and list the merge candidates so I can confirm. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 在「家庭」日曆建一個下週六下午 2 點的事件「大掃除」，提前一天提醒。
entries.en: Create an event called "Spring cleaning" in the "Family" calendar for next Saturday at 2 PM, with a reminder one day before. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出我所有日曆與事件數量，標出很久沒更新、可以封存的。
entries.en: List all of my calendars and how many events each one holds, and flag the ones that have not been updated in a long time and could be archived. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 幫我在 Deck 建一個「搬家計畫」看板，含待辦/進行中/完成三個列表，並加幾張常見任務卡片。
entries.en: Create a "Moving plan" board in Deck with three lists, To do / In progress / Done, and add a few cards for the usual tasks. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出 Deck 裡所有已逾期、未完成的卡片，依看板分組，提醒我處理。
entries.en: List every overdue, unfinished card in Deck, grouped by board, and remind me to deal with them. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 整理本週在 Deck 完成的卡片，做成一份簡短週報。
entries.en: Pull together the cards completed in Deck this week and turn them into a short weekly report. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 列出最近 30 天有多人編輯的 Office 文件，方便我掌握協作狀況。
entries.en: List the Office documents that more than one person has edited in the last 30 days, so I can see how collaboration is going. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 做一次 Nextcloud 健康檢查：伺服器版本、安全與設定警告、背景工作、儲存，逐項回報與建議。
entries.en: Run a Nextcloud health check: server version, security and setup warnings, background jobs, storage. Report each item in turn with a recommendation. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 檢查目前的 trusted_domains 設定，確認對外網址有在清單裡，沒有就提示我該加什麼。
entries.en: Check the current trusted_domains setting, confirm the public URL is on the list, and if it is not, tell me what to add. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 檢查背景工作（cron）是否正常執行，找出最久沒跑的工作並建議處理。
entries.en: Check whether background jobs (cron) are running properly, find the job that has gone longest without running, and suggest how to handle it. Answer in English.

entries.zh: 當整體儲存低於 15% 時，列出釋放空間的優先順序（回收桶、重複檔、超額使用者）。
entries.en: When overall storage drops below 15%, list the priority order for freeing space (trash bin, duplicate files, users over quota). Answer in English.
